name: Dangerfest 2026 // Afterparty & Dj
description:
Stavanger’s own punch in the face, Dangerface, are turning 10! 🔥 
They’re celebrating with a mini-festival at Parkteatret alongside some of our Oslo faves: Pappasaft, Forgetaboutit and Faenihælvette.

Right after the show, they’re rolling down to Brewgata to keep the party going with some tunes and a few cold ones. 🍻

The celebration after the celebration. You know where to find us! 🤘
